analysis_goal: 为已验证需求和验收标准生成可执行测试用例
raw_output:
{
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "test_case_id": "TC-001",
      "requirement_id": "REQ-001",
      "acceptance_criteria_ids": ["REQ-001-AC-1", "REQ-001-AC-2", "REQ-001-AC-3"],
      "title": "Verify free tier access and labeling without paywall interruption",
      "preconditions": [
        "User is not subscribed to any plan.",
        "App is installed and launched."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Open the app and navigate to the workout library.",
        "Count the number of distinct workouts available without a subscription.",
        "Check if each workout is labeled as 'Free' or 'Premium'.",
        "Select a free workout and start it.",
        "Complete the workout without encountering any paywall prompts."
      ],
      "expected_result": "At least 5 distinct workouts are accessible without a subscription. Each workout is clearly labeled as free or premium. The free workout can be completed without any paywall interruptions.",
      "test_type": "functional",
      "priority": "P1"
    },
    {
      "test_case_id": "TC-002",
      "requirement_id": "REQ-002",
      "acceptance_criteria_ids": ["REQ-002-AC-1", "REQ-002-AC-2", "REQ-002-AC-3", "REQ-002-AC-4"],
      "title": "Verify subscription transparency, trial reminder, in-app cancellation, and no unexpected charges",
      "preconditions": [
        "User has an active trial subscription.",
        "User is logged into the app."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Navigate to the subscription purchase screen.",
        "Verify that the price and renewal period are displayed before purchase.",
        "Set the trial to expire in 24 hours or less.",
        "Check that a reminder notification is received at least 24 hours before trial end.",
        "Go to the subscription settings in the app.",
        "Cancel the subscription directly within the app without contacting support.",
        "Wait for the trial period to end and check for any charges on the payment method."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Subscription details are visible before purchase. A reminder is received at least 24 hours before trial end. The user can cancel within the app without support. No unexpected charges occur after cancellation.",
      "test_type": "functional",
      "priority": "P1"
    },
    {
      "test_case_id": "TC-003",
      "requirement_id": "REQ-003",
      "acceptance_criteria_ids": ["REQ-003-AC-1", "REQ-003-AC-2", "REQ-003-AC-3"],
      "title": "Verify workout content realism, variety, and respectful imagery",
      "preconditions": [
        "User has access to the workout library."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Browse through multiple workout descriptions and images.",
        "Check that descriptions and images are realistic and not described as 'AI slop' or 'cheesy AI mockups'.",
        "Compare several workouts to ensure they are varied and not repetitive.",
        "Inspect imagery for any unrealistic or objectifying content."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Workout descriptions and images are realistic and not described as 'AI slop' or 'cheesy AI mockups'. Workouts are varied and not repetitive. No unrealistic or objectifying imagery is present.",
      "test_type": "functional",
      "priority": "P1"
    },
    {
      "test_case_id": "TC-004",
      "requirement_id": "REQ-004",
      "acceptance_criteria_ids": ["REQ-004-AC-1", "REQ-004-AC-2", "REQ-004-AC-3"],
      "title": "Verify ads are dismissible and do not redirect during workout",
      "preconditions": [
        "User is in a workout session.",
        "An ad is displayed."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Start a workout session.",
        "When an ad appears, locate the close button.",
        "Click the close button to dismiss the ad.",
        "Verify that the user returns to the workout without further interruption.",
        "Continue the workout and check that no external website redirects occur."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Ads have a clear and easily accessible close button. After dismissal, the user returns to the workout without further interruption. No external website redirects occur during the workout session.",
      "test_type": "functional",
      "priority": "P2"
    },
    {
      "test_case_id": "TC-005",
      "requirement_id": "REQ-005",
      "acceptance_criteria_ids": ["REQ-005-AC-1", "REQ-005-AC-2", "REQ-005-AC-3"],
      "title": "Verify user preferences are respected and plan settings persist",
      "preconditions": [
        "User has set a preference to avoid a specific body area (e.g., knees).",
        "User has customized plan settings."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Open the app and navigate to the workout plan.",
        "Check that no exercises targeting the avoided body area are included.",
        "Close the app and reopen it.",
        "Navigate to the plan settings and verify that the settings remain as previously set.",
        "Locate the option to review and adjust plan settings and confirm it is accessible."
      ],
      "expected_result": "No exercises target the avoided body area. Plan settings persist across sessions. The user can review and adjust plan settings at any time.",
      "test_type": "functional",
      "priority": "P2"
    },
    {
      "test_case_id": "TC-006",
      "requirement_id": "REQ-006",
      "acceptance_criteria_ids": ["REQ-006-AC-1", "REQ-006-AC-2", "REQ-006-AC-3"],
      "title": "Verify marketing and onboarding imagery is respectful and realistic",
      "preconditions": [
        "User is viewing marketing materials or onboarding screens."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Open the app's marketing page or onboarding flow.",
        "Inspect all images for unrealistic body proportions or objectification of women.",
        "Check that imagery focuses on fitness, strength, and health rather than sexualization.",
        "Collect user feedback or review comments to see if imagery is described as 'cheesy' or 'fake'."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Imagery does not depict unrealistic body proportions or objectify women. Imagery focuses on fitness, strength, and health. Users do not describe the imagery as 'cheesy' or 'fake'.",
      "test_type": "functional",
      "priority": "P2"
    }
  ]
}
